prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Home wait_info changes are consistently helpful, winning 5 out of 10 tests.
Adoption redesigns are generally helpful, winning 3 out of 4 tests.
Choose_path updates (copy, layout, redesign) showed no positive effect, ranging from no clear effect to performing worse across multiple tests.
Finish hints, sign-in notifications, and sign-in redesigns showed no positive effect, frequently leading to negative impacts or early test stops.
Adoption hints, home redesigns, finish layouts, finish new flows, sign-in copy, and sign-in incentives showed no clear effect across 2 or 3 tests each.
Predictions were systematically too low for big winning changes and too high for changes with no clear effect or negative outcomes; single-test categories remain thin evidence.

Changes:
0: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Interactive Mini Activity Display: Displays interactive pet activity hints and progress mini-updates while desktop companion assets generate in the background. (why: Home wait_info tests consistently win (50% success rate), addressing the massive mean wait time of 2,336s on the waiting screen.)
1: [adoption, redesign] Pick Friend Character Carousel Stage Redesign: Redesign the companion selection screen into a full stage carousel with trait callouts and sound previews. (why: Adoption redesigns are highly effective in past tests (75% win rate), helping boost completion from the adoption funnel step.)
2: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Companion Audio Routine Display: Plays subtle ambient companion sounds and displays progress status callouts while rendering pet files. (why: Home wait_info changes have strong win records, mitigating drop-off during long 200s+ median waiting periods.)
3: [finish, new_screen] Home Desktop Docking and Hide Interactive Screen: Adds a new onboarding screen after home intro showing how to dock, minimize, and summon the pet on screen. (why: Multiple support emails reported post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control, hide, or locate pets on the desktop.)
4: [finish, redesign] Home Intro Desktop Companion Stage Redesign: Redesign home intro into a stage layout featuring direct desktop action tips and quick launch options. (why: Clearer finish stage design helps prevent drop-off right before users reach their desktop pet.)
5: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Pet Personality Story Tracker Display: Displays live checklist updates of personality traits being synthesized for the pet while waiting. (why: Home wait_info features win regularly and maintain user engagement during high mean wait times (2336s).)
6: [adoption, new_flow] Custom Photo Upload Guided Preview Flow: Introduces a step-by-step guided upload and photo preview sequence for custom pet creation. (why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or visual glitches during photo rendering.)
7: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Companion Animation Preview Wait Info: Shows animated teasers of companion movement styles and desktop interactions while assets load. (why: Home wait_info changes are proven winners (50% win rate) to retain users during rendering delays.)
8: [adoption, redesign] Adoption Certificate Two Column Pet Showcase Redesign: Redesigns the adoption certificate screen into a two-column split screen highlighting companion attributes. (why: Adoption redesigns hold a 75% win rate in past experiments, increasing commitment before home transition.)
9: [adoption, hint] Photo Upload Trait Clarity Hint: Adds guidance on photo clarity, lighting, and angle directly on the custom pet photo upload screen. (why: Addresses support complaints regarding custom pets failing to generate or rendering with distorted visuals.)
